name: Programa de Pequeñas Donaciones del FMAM - Costa Rica

administered_by.name: UNDP Costa Rica (GEF Small Grants Programme)

summary: Costa Rica's GEF Small Grants country programme, run by UNDP, funds civil society and community-based organisations restoring fragile ecosystems such as mangroves, reefs, wetlands and forests, and community energy transition projects, with 12 to 18 month projects.
